## About Me

I am an **Urbanism Graduate (MSc, TU Delft)** specializing at the intersection of **Urban Analytics**, **Spatial Data Science**, and **Socio-Ecological Urban Design**\[cite: 1, 3, 4, 10\]. My research and practice leverage geospatial analysis, sentiment modeling, and spatial decision-support tools to inform public space design and urban restoration strategies\[cite: 1, 6, 9, 10\].

### Research & Focus Areas

-   **Digital Urban Memory & Public Space:** Scraping social media data (Twitter/X) to evaluate spatial sentiment and public space interventions\[cite: 6\].
-   **Spatial Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (S-MCDA):** Quantitative evaluation of urban stream restoration and climate adaptation strategies\[cite: 1, 10\].
-   **Urban Modeling & Visualization:** Integrating R, QGIS, Rhino, CityEngine, and Twinmotion for 3D spatial simulation\[cite: 2, 16\].
